subject: gk
question:
Which of the following statements are true regarding the Ravana Phadi cave at Aihole.

1.Nataraja is the important structure at this site.

2.This Nataraja image is surrounded on the right by four large saptamatrikas and on the left by three large ones.

3.The figures have slim, graceful bodies with long oval faces.

4.The temple shows a distinct feature of Pandya architecture of mixing and incorporation of several styles.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1, 2 and 3**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nataraja** is the important structure at the Ravana Phadi cave at Aihole.
 
• This Nataraja image is surrounded on the right by **four large saptamatrikas** and on the left by **three large ones**.
 
• The figures have **slim, graceful bodies with long oval faces**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Ravana Phadi cave is one of the oldest rock-cut temples in Aihole, Karnataka.
 
• The cave is believed to date back to the 6th century CE.
 
• The architecture of the cave is a blend of various styles, but it does not distinctly show features of Pandya architecture.
 
• The temple is renowned for its intricate carvings and historical significance in the development of early Chalukya architecture.
 
• The site is a testament to the artistic and cultural achievements of the period.
